_comment: The pair the version pin rests on. `policy_digest` is computed by tests/test_guardrail_pin_tracks_policy.py over the enforced policy in the synth snapshot; `description_digest` is what the CDK put in the guardrail version's description. They are taken over different material and will never be equal - the invariant is that NEITHER CAN MOVE ALONE. A policy change with a frozen description means the version resource will not be replaced, so `cdk deploy` reports UPDATE_COMPLETE while the gateway keeps enforcing the previous published version. That is ADR-024's failure arriving through the mechanism built to prevent it, and the Platform Engineering seat reproduced it with a one-word edit and 24 passing tests. Update BOTH values, after re-synthesising, in the PR that changes the policy.
guardrail_version_at_pin: v3 is deployed from the previous pin; this pin is the policy that publishes v4 when `enforcement-probing` deploys
